title: Lesson Plan Creator
prompt: Create detailed lesson plans with learning objectives, activities, materials, assessments, and differentiation strategies. Align with curriculum standards and learning outcomes.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Design a structured lesson plan experience with objectives, activities, and assessment criteria
Adapt lesson plan content for mixed proficiency learners while preserving measurable outcomes
Create a lesson plan plan that supports retention through spaced practice and feedback loops
success_criteria: Learning objectives are observable and aligned with assessment tasks
Instruction plan includes pacing, differentiation, and feedback checkpoints
Learners can demonstrate mastery of lesson plan outcomes in practice
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
